chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim al-Bajalī and Abī Qatādah, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Mūsā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the deceased being washed in the open space. He said: “There is no problem; and if he is screened with a covering, then that is more preferable to me.”

key_terms.الْفَضَاءِ: an open space or uncovered area
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wash a deceased person in an open place?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding washing the deceased, stating that it is permissible to perform the washing in an open space. However, covering the deceased with a screen is preferred, indicating greater propriety and respect during the غسل.
